ex.en: This laboratory is equipped with the latest computers.
ex.zh: 這間實驗室配備了最新的電腦。

ex.en: This laboratory is where we work every day.
ex.zh: 這間實驗室是我們每天工作的地方。

ex.en: A series of blasts reduced the laboratory to ruins.
ex.zh: 一連串的爆炸把實驗室炸成了廢墟。

ex.en: Mary keeps her laptop with her at all times.
ex.zh: 瑪麗總是把筆記型電腦帶在身上。

ex.en: Tom sat on his bed and opened his laptop.
ex.zh: 湯姆坐在床上，打開了筆記型電腦。

ex.en: The laptop provides cutting-edge technology at an affordable price.
ex.zh: 這台筆電以平實的價格提供最新的技術。

ex.en: Traffic was blocked by a landslide.
ex.zh: 交通因為山崩而中斷。

ex.en: Heavy rain caused a landslide near the village.
ex.zh: 豪雨在村莊附近引發土石流。

ex.en: She won the election by a landslide.
ex.zh: 她在選舉中大獲全勝。

ex.en: It was a landslide victory for the opposition party.
ex.zh: 這是反對黨的壓倒性勝利。

laundry.zh: 要洗（或洗好）的衣服；洗衣服

ex.en: I have to do laundry while it's still sunny.
ex.zh: 趁還有太陽，我得去洗衣服。

ex.en: Where should I put my laundry?
ex.zh: 我要洗的衣服該放哪裡？

ex.en: I'm doing the laundry while the weather is good.
ex.zh: 我趁天氣好在洗衣服。

ex.en: There's a laundry on the first floor of the building.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓一樓有洗衣房。

ex.en: I take my shirts to the laundry every week.
ex.zh: 我每週把襯衫送去洗衣店。

ex.en: Tom picked up the jar and read the label.
ex.zh: 湯姆拿起罐子讀標籤。

ex.en: The contents of the box are listed on the label.
ex.zh: 箱子裡裝什麼都寫在標籤上。

label.zh: 貼標籤；把…歸類為（常有負面意味）

ex.en: He's always putting labels on people.
ex.zh: 他老是給別人亂貼標籤。

ex.en: Please label each box with its contents.
ex.zh: 請在每個箱子上標明裡面的東西。

ex.en: The landlord says he wants to raise the rent.
ex.zh: 房東說他想漲房租。

ex.en: Why hasn't the landlord come to collect rent this month?
ex.zh: 為什麼這個月房東還不來收房租？

ex.en: Why did my sixty-year-old landlord buy a trampoline?
ex.zh: 我六十歲的房東為什麼要買彈簧床？

ex.en: The company announced 500 layoffs.
ex.zh: 公司宣布裁員 500 人。

ex.en: Many workers lost their jobs in the layoffs.
ex.zh: 很多工人在這波裁員中失業。

ex.en: My uncle's company launched a new product last month.
ex.zh: 我舅舅的公司上個月推出了一款新產品。

ex.en: Recently, this brand launched a series of limited edition underwear.
ex.zh: 最近這個品牌推出了一系列限量版內衣。

ex.en: Build your own championship team in a new football management simulation game, launching in early November.
ex.zh: 全新足球經理模擬遊戲將於 11 月初推出，邀你打造屬於自己的冠軍球隊。

ex.en: They are going to launch an artificial satellite tomorrow.
ex.zh: 他們明天要發射一顆人造衛星。

ex.en: A satellite was launched in Russia last year.
ex.zh: 去年俄羅斯發射了一顆衛星。

ex.en: The launch was successful. We're now leaving the solar system.
ex.zh: 發射成功。我們正在離開太陽系。

ex.en: The product launch is scheduled for May.
ex.zh: 產品預計五月上市。

ex.en: We had a three-hour layover in Singapore.
ex.zh: 我們在新加坡轉機停留了三個小時。

ex.en: If your layover is long enough, you can leave the airport and explore the city.
ex.zh: 如果轉機時間夠長，你可以出機場逛逛這座城市。

ex.en: A historical landmark has been restored and will reopen.
ex.zh: 一座歷史地標已經修復並將重新開放。

ex.en: The tower is a famous landmark in the city.
ex.zh: 那座塔是這座城市著名的地標。

ex.en: The agreement was a landmark in the country's history.
ex.zh: 這項協議是該國歷史上的里程碑。

ex.en: The court made a landmark decision on the case.
ex.zh: 法院對此案做出了具有里程碑意義的判決。

ex.en: The man is using the landline to call.
ex.zh: 那個男人正在用市內電話打電話。

ex.en: Few young people have a landline these days.
ex.zh: 現在很少年輕人有市內電話。
